notes.bambi: Kiingereza hutumia “sorry” kwa pole na kwa samahani.
notes.samahani: Excuse me ni kumwita mtu au kupita; sorry ni kuomba msamaha.

guidebook.intro: Kiswahili mara nyingi “kina” hisia (**nina furaha**). Kiingereza “kiko” nayo: **I am happy**.

tips.title: I am happy
body: **Nina furaha** si “I have happiness”, ni **I am happy**. Vivyo hivyo: **I’m sad** (nina huzuni), **I’m worried** (nina wasiwasi), **she’s angry** (ana hasira).
Hisia za **-me-** pia hutumia **am**: **nimefurahi → I’m glad**, **nimeshangaa → I’m surprised**, **nimechoka → I’m tired**.

tips.title: Worried about, afraid of
body: Hisia huja na kihusishi chake: **worried about** (wasiwasi kuhusu), **afraid of** (kuogopa), **happy for** (kufurahi kwa ajili ya).
**I’m afraid of dogs** ni naogopa mbwa. **Don’t worry!** ni usijali.

culture.title: Sorry na congratulations
body: **Pole** ina tafsiri nyingi: **I’m sorry** (kwa msiba), **Oh no!** au **Are you okay?** (mtu akianguka). **Hongera** ni **Congratulations!** au **Well done!**
